parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window, RFC 3339. Compared against each row's day bucket.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window, RFC 3339. A window whose `to` is not after `from` is not rejected; it simply matches no rows.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional exact-match filter on the row scope (a site code or a zone id). Omit it, or send it empty, for every scope including the catalog-wide one.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket resolution. Only daily buckets are modelled.
